details.failure_summary: Playwright Locator.wait_for timeout (5000ms) exceeded in custom node configuration test — failed on all 3 retry attempts
details.reasoning: The test failed consistently across all 3 retry attempts (screenshots captured at 162256, 162314, 162332), each time with a Playwright TimeoutError waiting for a locator. Retries rule out a transient flake. The consistent failure on the same step strongly suggests a real product regression in the custom node configuration UI (e.g., an element that no longer appears or renders differently). INVESTIGATE is warranted.

The case requires a second, non-public project to fork FROM.' This is a test environment/data setup problem — the required second project does not exist for the test account in the DEV environment.
